description: A lean wanderer in patched wool, rough trousers, and a faded red neckerchief.
name: Drifter

parts.brief: threadbare charcoal trousers with wrapped cloth gaiters over dull grey boots
patched brown wool tunic with a frayed red bandana tied high around the neck
frayed grey sleeve down to a bandaged wrist and relaxed hand
frayed grey sleeve ending in a bare hand shaped to grip a hilt
lean, shadowed face with scruff on the jaw and wary eyes
shaggy matted dark brown hair hanging low over the forehead and ears
